local M32 = 4294967296

local function mul(a, b)
	local ah = math.floor(a / 65536)
	local al = a % 65536
	return (((ah * b) % 65536) * 65536 + al * b) % M32
end

local function fold(s, salt)
	local h = salt
	for i = 1, #s do
		h = mul(bxor(h, string.byte(s, i)), 16777619)
	end
	h = mul(bxor(h, rshift(h, 15)), 2246822519)
	h = mul(bxor(h, rshift(h, 13)), 3266489917)
	return bxor(h, rshift(h, 16))
end

local function stretch(h)
	for i = 1, 3000 do
		h = (mul(bxor(h, i), 2654435761) + 40503) % M32
		h = bxor(h, rshift(h, 16))
	end
	return h
end

local function unpack_payload(seed, step)
	local map = {}
	for i = 1, 64 do
		map[string.byte(ALPHA, i)] = i - 1
	end
	local byte, char, concat, floor = string.byte, string.char, table.concat, math.floor
	local s, sum = seed, 5381
	local out = {}
	local total = #PIECES
	for pi = 1, total do
		local piece = PIECES[pi]
		local buf, n = {}, 0
		for i = 1, #piece, 4 do
			local a, b, c, d = byte(piece, i, i + 3)
			local v = map[a] * 262144 + map[b] * 4096 + map[c] * 64 + map[d]
			local x1 = floor(v / 65536)
			local x2 = floor(v / 256) % 256
			local x3 = v % 256
			s = bxor(s, lshift(s, 13))
			s = bxor(s, rshift(s, 17))
			s = bxor(s, lshift(s, 5))
			x1 = bxor(x1, bxor(rshift(s, 24), band(s, 255)))
			s = bxor(s, lshift(s, 13))
			s = bxor(s, rshift(s, 17))
			s = bxor(s, lshift(s, 5))
			x2 = bxor(x2, bxor(rshift(s, 24), band(s, 255)))
			s = bxor(s, lshift(s, 13))
			s = bxor(s, rshift(s, 17))
			s = bxor(s, lshift(s, 5))
			x3 = bxor(x3, bxor(rshift(s, 24), band(s, 255)))
			sum = (sum * 33 + x1) % M32
			sum = (sum * 33 + x2) % M32
			sum = (sum * 33 + x3) % M32
			n = n + 1
			buf[n] = char(x1, x2, x3)
		end
		out[pi] = concat(buf)
		if pi % 8 == 0 then step(pi / total) end
	end
	local src = concat(out)
	return string.sub(src, 1, PLEN), sum
end

local EASE, DIR = Enum.EasingStyle, Enum.EasingDirection

local function new(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end

local function tw(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tween = TS:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or EASE.Quint, dir or DIR.Out), props)
	tween:Play()
	return tween
end

local function text(props, parent)
	local base = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextColor3 = TXT,
		TextSize = 12,
		Text = "",
	}
	for k, v in pairs(props) do base[k] = v end
	return new("TextLabel", base, parent)
end

local function corner(o, r)
	return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = r}, o)
end

local function seq(...)
	local pts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs({...}) do
		pts[#pts + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], p[2])
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(pts)
end

local logN = 0
local function log(tag, msg)
	logN = logN + 1
	local col = (tag == "ok") and "50e18c" or ((tag == "!!") and "ff5f69" or "8c8ca8")
	local l = text({
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13),
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
		TextSize = 10,
		RichText = true,
		TextColor3 = SUB,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = logN,
		Text = string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>  %s', col, tag, msg),
	}, logBox)
	tw(l, 0.35, {TextTransparency = 0.2}, EASE.Sine)
	local kids = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(logBox:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("TextLabel") then kids[#kids + 1] = c end
	end
	table.sort(kids, function(a, b) return a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder end)
	for i, c in ipairs(kids) do
		local age = #kids - i
		if age >= 4 then
			c:Destroy()
		elseif age > 0 then
			tw(c, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 0.35 + age * 0.17}, EASE.Sine)
		end
	end
end

local function ripple(host, hostBtn)
	local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
	local ap, as = host.AbsolutePosition, host.AbsoluteSize
	local sc = math.max(rootScale.Scale, 0.01)
	local rx = math.clamp((m.X - ap.X) / sc, 0, as.X / sc)
	local ry = math.clamp((m.Y - ap.Y) / sc, 0, as.Y / sc)
	local r = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rx, ry),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 3,
	}, host)
	corner(r, UDim.new(0.5, 0))
	local d = math.max(as.X, as.Y) / sc * 2.4
	tw(r, 0.6, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, EASE.Quad)
	task.delay(0.65, function() r:Destroy() end)
end

	idle = {SUB, "ожидание ключа", LINE},
	busy = {ACC2, "проверка", ACC},
	bad = {BAD, "доступ закрыт", BAD},
	good = {GOOD, "доступ открыт", GOOD},
}
local function setState(kind, label)
	local s = STATE[kind]
	pulse = (kind == "idle")
	tw(stateDot, 0.25, {BackgroundColor3 = s[1], BackgroundTransparency = 0}, EASE.Sine)
	tw(stateL, 0.25, {TextColor3 = s[1]}, EASE.Sine)
	stateL.Text = label or s[2]
	tw(inputStroke, 0.25, {Color = s[3]}, EASE.Sine)
end

		for _, o in ipairs({11, -9, 7, -5, 3, 0}) do
			tw(card, 0.045, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(o, 51)}, EASE.Linear)

		end
	end)
end

	tw(card, 0.35, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 68), GroupTransparency = 1}, EASE.Quad)
	task.wait(0.38)
	card.Visible = false
end

local alive = true
local hb
local t0 = os.clock()
local lastUp = ""

local function cleanup()
	alive = false
	if hb then hb:Disconnect() hb = nil end
	pcall(function() blur:Destroy() end)
	pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
	genv.__AuraBootClean = nil
end
genv.__AuraBootClean = cleanup

hb = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local t = os.clock() - t0
	g1.Rotation = (t * 210) % 360
	g2.Rotation = (-t * 62) % 360
	dia.Rotation = 45 + math.sin(t * 1.3) * 7
	local k = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2.4)
	core.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7 + k * 3, 7 + k * 3)
	glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, t * 0.7) * (0.07 + 0.03 * math.sin(t * 1.5))
	shimmer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-60 + ((t * 0.8) % 1.5) / 1.5 * 330, 0)
	if pulse and card.Visible then
		stateDot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 - 0.45 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3))
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(particles) do
		p.y = p.y - p.sp * dt
		if p.y < -0.03 then
			p.y = 1.03
			p.x = rng:NextNumber(0.03, 0.97)
		end
		p.f.Position = UDim2.new(p.x, math.sin(t * 0.6 + p.ph) * p.am, p.y, 0)
	end
	local up = string.format("t+%.1fs", t)
	if up ~= lastUp then
		lastUp = up
		upL.Text = up
	end
end)

local function bail(msg)
	log("!!", "failed")
	tw(barG, 0.3, {GroupTransparency = 1}, EASE.Sine)
	layoutKey()
	task.wait(0.5)
	showCard()
	setState("bad", msg)
	btnState("Подтвердить", ACC)
	box.TextEditable = true
	busy = false
	shake()
end

local function startLock()
	locked = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while alive and fail.lock > os.time() do
			local left = fail.lock - os.time()
			submitBtn.Text = "Подождите " .. left .. "с"
			stateL.Text = "слишком много попыток"
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		if not alive then return end
		locked = false
		busy = false
		box.TextEditable = true
		btnState("Подтвердить", ACC)
		setState("idle")
	end)
end

local function trim(s)
	return (string.lower((s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))))
end

local function accept(key)
	setState("good")
	btnState("Ключ принят", GOOD)
	log("ok", "key.verify")
	task.wait(0.6)
	hideCard()
	local seed = stretch(fold(key, SALT_B))
	if seed == 0 then seed = 1 end
	key = nil
	if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
		bail("среда не поддерживает loadstring")
		return
	end
	pv.Value = 0
	layoutLoad()
	task.wait(0.4)
	tw(barG, 0.4, {GroupTransparency = 0}, EASE.Sine)
	setStatus("Расшифровка модулей")
	task.wait(0.2)
	local ok, src, sum = pcall(unpack_payload, seed, function(f)
		tw(pv, 0.2, {Value = f * 0.9}, EASE.Linear)
		task.wait()
	end)
	seed = nil
	if not ok or sum ~= PSUM then
		bail("ошибка расшифровки")
		return
	end
	log("ok", "payload.unpack")
	setBar(0.96, 0.3)
	setStatus("Сборка меню")
	local fn = loadstring(src, "=AuraMenu")
	src = nil
	if not fn then
		bail("ошибка загрузки модуля")
		return
	end
	setBar(1, 0.35)
	task.wait(0.35)
	setStatus("Запуск")
	log("ok", "handoff")
	task.wait(0.45)
	tw(stage, 0.6, {GroupTransparency = 1}, EASE.Sine)
	tw(back, 0.75, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, EASE.Sine)
	tw(blur, 0.75, {Size = 0}, EASE.Sine)
	task.delay(0.3, function()
		local ran, err = pcall(fn)
		if not ran then warn("[Aura] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end)
	task.wait(0.9)
	cleanup()
end

submit = function()
	if busy or locked or not alive then return end
	local key = trim(box.Text)
	if key == "" then
		setState("bad", "введите ключ")
		shake()
		task.delay(1.4, function()
			if not busy and not locked and alive then setState("idle") end
		end)
		return
	end
	if fail.lock > os.time() then
		startLock()
		return
	end
	busy = true
	box.TextEditable = false
	box:ReleaseFocus()
	setState("busy")
	btnState("Проверка", ACC)
	task.spawn(function()
		local dots = 0
		while busy and alive and submitBtn.Text:find("Проверка", 1, true) == 1 do
			dots = (dots + 1) % 4
			submitBtn.Text = "Проверка" .. string.rep(".", dots)
			task.wait(0.18)
		end
	end)
	task.wait(0.7)
	local good = (stretch(fold(key, SALT_A)) == VER)
	if good then
		fail.n = 0
		fail.lock = 0
		accept(key)
	else
		fail.n = fail.n + 1
		busy = false
		box.TextEditable = true
		btnState("Подтвердить", ACC)
		setState("bad", "неверный ключ")
		shake()
		if fail.n >= 3 then
			local secs = math.min(15 * 2 ^ (fail.n - 3), 180)
			fail.lock = os.time() + secs
			busy = true
			startLock()
		else
			task.delay(1.6, function()
				if not busy and not locked and alive then
					setState("idle")
					tw(inputStroke, 0.25, {Color = LINE}, EASE.Sine)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

submitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if busy or locked then return end
	ripple(submitG, submitBtn)
	submit()
end)

task.spawn(function()
	tw(back, 0.8, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}, EASE.Sine)
	tw(blur, 1.1, {Size = 16}, EASE.Sine)
	tw(stage, 0.6, {GroupTransparency = 0}, EASE.Sine)
	tw(holderScale, 1, {Scale = 1}, EASE.Back)
	task.wait(0.35)
	for i, l in ipairs(letters) do
		task.delay((i - 1) * 0.09, function()
			tw(l.l, 0.5, {TextTransparency = 0}, EASE.Sine)
			tw(l.s, 0.55, {Scale = 1}, EASE.Back)
		end)
	end
	task.wait(0.45)
	tw(underline, 0.7, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 2)}, EASE.Quint)
	tw(subL, 0.6, {TextTransparency = 0}, EASE.Sine)
	task.wait(0.35)
	tw(barG, 0.4, {GroupTransparency = 0}, EASE.Sine)
	setStatus("Подготовка окружения")

	local steps = {
		{0.16, "Подготовка окружения", "runtime.init", 0.55},
		{0.39, "Проверка совместимости", "env.check", 0.7},
		{0.64, "Загрузка ресурсов", "assets.index", 0.85},
		{0.91, "Сборка интерфейса", "ui.compose", 0.75},
		{1, "Готово", "ready", 0.4},
	}
	for i, s in ipairs(steps) do
		if not alive then return end
		if i > 1 then setStatus(s[2]) end
		setBar(s[1], s[4])
		task.wait(s[4] * 0.8)
		log("ok", s[3])
		task.wait(s[4] * 0.2 + rng:NextNumber(0.05, 0.2))
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
	tw(barG, 0.35, {GroupTransparency = 1}, EASE.Sine)
	task.wait(0.3)
	layoutKey()
	task.wait(0.35)
	log("..", "awaiting key")
	showCard()
	task.wait(0.7)
	setState("idle")
end)
